find_item.description: Find stock items by description or code (e.g. '500 Wh battery pack'). Returns active items, best match first, with code, unit and whether they are lithium-cell parts.

find_supplier.description: Look a supplier up by name, tolerating different spellings. Returns the closest matches with code, city, status and whether they hold a valid UN 38.3 certificate. Use it before registering anyone new.

check_budget.description: Is a cost centre open, and how much budget is left this quarter? Without a code, lists every open cost centre.

create_purchase_request.description: Raise a purchase request (PR): the internal ask to buy something. With confirm=false it previews the estimated value and who must approve; with confirm=true it saves and submits it. Within your limit it is approved at once; above it, it waits for your manager.

approve_purchase_request.description: Approve or reject a purchase request that waits for the signed-in user. Only the named approver can do this, never the person who raised it.

order_status.description: The real status of a purchase order or a purchase request, read from Ledgerline, with approval, goods received and any warning.
